primary_estimand.population: all preregistered confirmatory benchmark cases eligible under the frozen benchmark/oracle contract
primary_estimand.arm_binding_rule: exact executable arm IDs are imported from accepted WP-004 before confirmatory execution; best-DEV-arm selection is forbidden

primary_analysis.point_estimate: mean paired case-level treatment-minus-control correctness difference
primary_analysis.variance: source-family cluster-robust sandwich variance for intercept-only paired differences
primary_analysis.small_cluster_rule: if fewer than 30 independent source-family clusters remain, asymptotic primary PASS is prohibited and a separately preregistered finite-cluster randomization/bootstrap method is required before confirmatory scoring

publication_composite.rule: correct only when every publication-critical applicable field is correct
publication_composite.infrastructure_failure: retained and handled under frozen missingness/infrastructure rules, never silently dropped as success

multiplicity.exploratory: reported with effect sizes and uncertainty, explicitly non-confirmatory

selection_prohibitions: choose treatment arm by best DEV composite result
choose baseline by weakest DEV result
change SESOI after observing directional treatment difference
change alpha or target power after observing results
drop difficult source families to reach significance
replace final endpoint with a favorable field-level endpoint
treat secondary or exploratory significance as the preregistered primary claim
